name: CareOps Legacy Governance Reference
purpose: Allow reconciled historical source observations to be referenced in a governance case without treating them as current authority or a decision.
rules: A legacy reference cannot create a committee recommendation or delegated decision.
A legacy reference cannot establish current registration, qualification, scope, condition, supervision, approval, expiry or authority.
Current decisions must use current evidence, current authority and the normal human process.
Source provenance and reconciliation evidence remain linked and immutable.
A changed or missing source record creates an exception rather than an automatic adverse outcome.
No raw source payload, patient information, practitioner evidence or sensitive narrative is stored in Git.
